items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: And the Cuckoo was playing trumpet. Playing trumpet, yeah. And we worked there a year and, but six months.

ctx.x: Charlie Hamilton was playing with you, remember? Charlie Hamilton was playing piano, yeah.
And the Cuckoo was playing trumpet. Playing trumpet, yeah. And we worked there a year and, but six months.
It was your standard band, pretty much, huh? Yeah. Except you had Hamilton. I don't think Hamilton ever made any recordings either. I don't know.
